english.title: Carry on business under name likely to give false impression connected to foreign government / organisation etc
english.standardoffencewording:

(A)_[a body corporate,]_
(B)_[an officer of a body corporate, namely, **(..SPECIFY THE BODY COPORATE..),]_

carried on business in the United Kingdom under a name likely to give false impression that business was connected with

(C)_[a foreign government]_
(D)_[an agency of a foreign government]_
(E)_[an authority of a foreign government]_
(F)_[an international organisation whose members include two or more countries]_
(G)_[an international organisation whose members include two or more territories]_

english.notes:
(i) Where an offence under this section is committed by a body corporate, an offence is also committed by every officer of the body who is in default, see section 1196A(3) of the Companies Act 2006.
(ii) Civil financial penalties may be issued by the registrar for this offence being a ‘relevant offence’ as defined by section 1132A of the Companies Act 2006. No criminal proceedings may be commenced against a person in respect of conduct amounting to an offence if the person has already been given a financial penalty by the registrar. Further, no financial penalty may be imposed on a person in relation to conduct amounting to an offence if proceedings in respect of that offence are ongoing or the person has been convicted.
